title: LEAKING AIR FROM THE FIRST NIGHT - SAVE YOUR MONEY
text:
LEAKING AIR FROM THE FIRST NIGHT - SAVE YOUR MONEY. I have used an old basic full size flocked top Aerobed for nightly use because of back problems and it worked great. I used it (petite female) nightly for about 2 years straight before it started to have a strange lump and inner breakage. Still, the old one I got in 2003, worked great when I put it to use the last couple years. After the way it held up and was so comfortable, I got a new one just the same size etc, to replace the old one. I got the new one just over a year ago. The new one looked about the same, except as soon as I put the air in it, the first night it was already leaking, the 2nd and 3rd nights it was so bad, it was totally out of air within a few hours of use. I didn't jump on it, or abuse it in any way at all. I contacted the Aerobed store online. I was very disappointed and surprised when they (after it says it has a 1 year guarantee), that they gave me the run around. There was no quick exchange, and though I emailed again, and called, they still have never given me a refund or even offered to give me an exchange.
Instead they made it as difficult as possible until I gave up.
I had to just throw the bed out. I am now not sure if it is worth trying another one. Too bad they have such bad customer service. Buyer beware.

product_metadata.title: AeroBed Extra Bed with Built-in Pump, Full
features: Fast inflation and deflation with built-in pump
Oval coil construction adds extra support
Constructed of heavy-gauge, puncture-resistant PVC vinyl
Full size measures 74-inch by 54-inch by 9-inch high when inflated
description: The AeroBed Extra Bed provides the perfect combination of features for comfort, convenience, and reliability so you or your guests will sleep in style. The full-sized Extra Bed measures 74-inch long by 54-inch wide by 9-inch high when inflated, and features a soft, flocked fleece surface for extra comfort. The bed's oval coil construction ensures extra support, all night long. The mattress is constructed of heavy-gauge, puncture resistant PVC vinyl, with a cleanable surface for the ultimate in convenience. The powerful built-in pump inflates the bed in just 3-minute and the AeroBed's famous Whoosh valve lets you deflate the bed in just 15-second. The AeroBed comes with a handy storage bag, so it's easy to transport and store.

details.Warranty Description: Air bed 1 year limited warranty; pump 2 year warranty.
